description: Resolve first-purchase discovery for an authenticated internal purchaser in a hosted Pro PSA workspace using its edition, billing mode, account read/update permissions and the existing purchase-surface policy.
Contribute exactly one Co-Managed IT link for either an eligible purchaser or an authorized existing participant, with separate eligibility for the archive link.
Let the server root layout, page and metadata accept the eligible purchaser while preserving the product-specific customer home and the existing operational and child-route gates.
Show the eligible purchaser verified zero-seat totals and a Buy co-managed seats action without a client selection, relationship query or co-management grant.
Open the existing pool editor for a positive first target, quote it in the configured currency and submit through the existing confirmed purchase and checkout flow.
Restore an in-flight first purchase and its original target from tenant-scoped state after a return or refresh, including when an unpaid hosted entitlement row exists.
Represent a completed purchase request awaiting paid reconciliation on the overview, keeping its entry reachable and preventing another first charge during verification.

Refresh the sponsor’s verified pool totals and access state after reconciliation, keeping the result accessible to an account-only purchaser and the ordinary admission path available to an authorized MSP administrator.
Preserve account purchase, client-scoped shortfall and allocation behavior, and operational-only and customer reads under their current capability and permission rules.
Place commercial discovery and its UI in the EE implementation of the existing composition seams and make the CE host inert even when rollout or price settings are populated.
